name: PUT mapping with duplicate dynamic template names emits a warning

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.6.0-3bca3d4a913632e6f76c52d3b6170812f328c054 "Dynamic template [my_template] in index [test_dup_templates] is defined more than once.
